description: This file defines the PatientProvider class, which manages patient data using a service; it handles loading, updating, and error states, and notifies listeners on changes.

classes.name: PatientProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier class managing the state of a Patient object, including loading and error states, and interacting with PatientService.

methods.name: loadByUserId
methods.description: Fetches a Patient by user ID from the service and updates state accordingly.

methods.name: registerOrUpdate
methods.description: Creates or updates a Patient record via the service and updates state accordingly.

methods.name: _setLoading
methods.description: Helper method to set the loading state and notify listeners.
